Energy Sink.name: 能量汇流器 Energy Sink
Energy Sink.description:
你可以将一部分用于遏制并引导破坏性能量的魔法转入你的护甲中，以保护你免受伤害。如果你的下一个动作是施放一个至少造成一种能量伤害类型（强酸、寒冷、电击、火焰、力场、音波、活力或虚空）的法术，则你获得你所选择的一种能量伤害类型的抗性，数值等于该法术环级的两倍，持续1分钟。无论你的法术是否造成了伤害，你都会获得该抗性。

越狱 如果你将越狱法术与这个塑法搭配使用，你获得对所有能量伤害的抗性，数值等于该法术环级的两倍。

You can divert some of the magic used to contain and direct destructive energy into your armor to protect you from harm. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals at least one type of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void), you gain resistance to an energy damage type of your choice equal to twice the spell's rank for 1 minute. You get the resistance regardless of whether or not your spell dealt damage.

Jailbreak If you use Jailbreak Spell with this spellshape, you gain resistance to all energy damage equal to twice the spell's rank.

Overclock Brain.name: 超频大脑 Overclock Brain
Overclock Brain.description:
你将魔法能量注入自身，以加快你的攻击。你获得 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速}状态，并且每轮可以将这个额外动作用于进行打击。

You infuse yourself with magic energy to speed up your attacks. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round to Strike.

Dynamic Frequency Scaling.name: 动态频率缩放 Dynamic Frequency Scaling
Dynamic Frequency Scaling.description:
通过提供你自己的魔法能量，你将混合物品所使用的魔法能量降到最低，保护它们精密的晶格免于磨损，使其能够再次使用。如果你的下一动作是从法术宝石中施放法术，则该法术宝石不会被摧毁，而是变为一个无法出售的临时物品，并且只会持续到你再次使用它或你下一次进行每日准备时（以先发生者为准）。如果你的下一动作是从一个今天已经使用过一次的法术宝石中施放法术，则它会被摧毁。

越狱 如果你使用越狱法术来让此法术塑形作用于一枚法术宝石，则它只会在严重失败时变为损坏状态。

By supplying your own magic energy, you minimize the amount of magic energy used by your hybrid items, protecting their delicate lattice from wear so they can be used again. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from a spell gem, instead of being destroyed, the spell gem becomes a temporary item that can't be sold and only lasts until you use it again or the next time you make your daily preparations (whichever comes first). If your next action is to Cast a Spell from a spell gem that has already been used once today, it is destroyed.

Jailbreak If you use Jailbreak Spell to use this spellshape with a spell gem, it only becomes broken on a critical failure.

Overclock Minion.name: 超频仆从 Overclock Minion
Overclock Minion.description:
你向仆从注入残余的魔法能量，以提高其速度。目标获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{加速}状态，且每轮只能将该额外动作用于Stride或Strike动作。

You infuse your minion with leftover magical energy to increase its speed. The target gains the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can only use the extra action each round for Stride or Strike actions.

Thermoelectric Phase Change.name: 热电相变 Thermoelectric Phase Change
Thermoelectric Phase Change.description:
你编译出一段程序，以改变你的魔法所输出的能量类型。若你的下一动作是施放一个无持续时间、具有元素特征（气、地、火、金、水或木）且只造成一种伤害类型的法术，则将其元素特征替换为另一种元素特征，并将其造成的伤害替换为对应的伤害类型之一：气（电击或音波）、地（钝击或穿刺）、金（酸蚀或挥砍）、火（火焰）、水（寒冷）、木（毒素）。

越狱 若你使用“越狱法术”配合此法术塑形来修改一个使用基础豁免或法术攻击检定的法术，则每个在该法术的基础豁免中掷出大失败，或被该法术的攻击检定重击的生物，还会额外受到 1d6 点与该法术所选类型相同的持续性伤害。不要因该法术的升阶条目而增加持续性伤害的数值。

You compile a program to alter the type of energy that's output by your magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with no duration that has an elemental trait (air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood) and deals one type of damage, replace the elemental trait with a different elemental trait and the damage it deals with one of the corresponding damage types: air (electricity or sonic), earth (bludgeoning or piercing), metal (acid or slashing), fire (fire), water (cold), wood (poison).

Jailbreak If you use Jailbreak Spell with this spellshape to modify a spell that uses a basic save or spell attack roll, each creature who rolled a critical failure against the spell's basic saving throw or were critically hit by the spell's attack roll additionally takes 1d6 persistent damage of the same type chosen for the spell. Do not increase the amount of persistent damage dealt due to the spell's heightened entry.

Overclock Armor.name: 超频护甲 Overclock Armor
Overclock Armor.description:
你将魔法能量注入护甲，以增强你的防御。你具现出一层包裹护甲的闪烁能量层，其作用等同于一个 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.2637b5l0hxitACkR]{卓越型力场}。随后，你在10分钟内免疫过载护甲。

升阶（7环） 该能量改为等同于一个 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.YZjmnoJD64oLMQ7q]{菁英型力场}。

升阶（9环） 该能量改为等同于一个 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.6hunzJ4gwfNT58vl]{终极型力场}。

You infuse your armor with magical energy to bolster your defense. You materialize a shimmering layer of energy encasing your armor that functions as a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.2637b5l0hxitACkR]{superior force field}. You then become immune to overclock armor for 10 minutes.

Heightened (7th) The energy functions as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.YZjmnoJD64oLMQ7q]{elite force field} instead.

Heightened (9th) The energy functions as an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.6hunzJ4gwfNT58vl]{ultimate force field} instead.

Holographic Creature.name: 全息生物 Holographic Creature
Holographic Creature.description:
你将附近的光子编织成一个大型或更小生物的虚幻全息影像。它会发出相应的声音、气味，并且触碰起来也足以乱真。如果你与该全息影像之间的距离超过500英尺，法术结束。

该全息影像不能说话，但你可以用你的动作通过它发声，而法术会将你的声音适当地伪装。你可能需要进行一次欺骗或表演检定来模仿该生物，具体由GM决定。如果你试图模仿某个特定人物的举止，或与认识那个人的人互动，这种情况尤其可能发生。

在战斗中，该全息影像每回合可以使用2个动作，而这些动作会在你维持法术时使用。它可以用任意自己想要的移动类型进行疾奔，最多移动20英尺，因为它并非真实存在。它的攻击检定使用你的法术攻击检定，AC使用你的法术DC。它的豁免调整值等于你的法术DC – 10。它足够实体化，因此可以与其他生物形成夹击。如果该全息影像被一次攻击命中或豁免失败，法术结束。

该全息影像可以通过让目标相信其攻击是真实的来造成伤害，但除此之外，它不能直接影响物理世界。如果该全息影像用一次打击命中，目标受到2d6点精神伤害。此伤害具有精神效果。该全息影像的打击具有非致命特性。如果这伤害与该生物的影像不相符——例如，一个大型龙的全息影像却只造成5点伤害——GM可能会允许目标立刻尝试一次察觉检定，以识破该法术。

任何接触该全息影像的生物，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} 动作对其进行检查的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻觉。

强化（+1） 该全息影像打击的伤害增加1d4，且你能创造的生物最大体型提高一级（最大为巨型）。最大持续时间也增加1分钟。

You weave nearby photons into an illusory hologram of a Large or smaller creature. It generates the appropriate sounds, smells, and feels believable to the touch. If you and the hologram are ever farther than 500 feet apart, the spell ends.

The hologram can't speak, but you can use your actions to speak through it, with the spell disguising your voice as appropriate. You might need to attempt a Deception or Performance check to mimic the creature, as determined by the GM. This is especially likely if you're trying to imitate a specific person's mannerisms or engage with someone that person knows.

In combat, the hologram can use 2 actions per turn, which it uses when you Sustain the Spell. It can Stride up to 20 feet using any movement type it wishes, as it's not real. It uses your spell attack roll for attack rolls and your spell DC for its AC. Its saving throw modifiers are equal to your spell DC – 10. It's substantial enough that it can flank other creatures. If the hologram is hit by an attack or fails a save, the spell ends.

The hologram can cause damage by making the target believe the hologram's attacks are real, but it cannot otherwise directly affect the physical world. If the hologram hits with a Strike, the target takes 2d6 mental damage. This damage is a mental effect. The hologram's Strikes are nonlethal. If the damage doesn't correspond to the image of the creature—for example, if a holographic Large dragon deals only 5 damage—the GM might allow the target to attempt an immediate Perception check to disbelieve the spell.

Any creature that touches the hologram or uses the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the hologram's Strikes increases by 1d4, and the maximum size of creature you can create increases by one (to a maximum of Gargantuan). The maximum duration also increases by 1 minute.

Liminal Hyperlink.name: 阈限超链接 Liminal Hyperlink
Liminal Hyperlink.description:
你重编现实，将两个空间连接在一起。在效果线内、彼此至少相距15英尺的未被占据方格中创造两个超链接。当一个生物进入某个超链接的空间时，它会从另一个超链接邻接的、由其自行选择的未被占据空间中出现。未在飞行的生物将所有缺乏坚实地面的空间视为被占据。如果该生物没有可进入的有效空间，那么两个超链接都会坍缩，而该生物仍留在它进入第一个超链接时所在的空间中。

You reprogram reality to link together two spaces. Create two hyperlinks in unoccupied squares in line of effect that are at least 15 feet apart. When a creature enters a hyperlink's space, they emerge in an unoccupied space of their choice adjacent to the other hyperlink. A creature that isn't flying treats all spaces lacking solid ground as occupied. If there is no valid space for the creature to enter, then both hyperlinks collapse and the creature remains in the space where it entered the first hyperlink.

Overclock Lattice.name: 超频晶格 Overclock Lattice
Overclock Lattice.description:
魔法电路在你全身炽烈闪耀，为你的法术代码赋能。当你通过启动法术芯片或法术宝石来施放法术时，将该法术升阶至至多比你所拥有的最高环级法术位低2环。

越狱 如果你使用“越狱法术”来运用这一法术塑形，则你可以将该法术升阶至与你为超频装备而施放的法术相同的环级。

Magical circuitry blazes all over your body and empowers your spell code. When you Cast a Spell by activating a spell chip or spell gem, heighten the spell up to 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have.

Jailbreak If you use Jailbreak Spell to use this spellshape, you can heighten the spell up to the same rank as the spell you cast to overclock your gear.

Virtualized Data Transmission.name: 虚拟化数据传输 Virtualized Data Transmission
Virtualized Data Transmission.description:
需求 你正持用一把具有科技特征的远程武器。

你运用自己的魔法将自身数字化，以在战场上移动。如果你的下一动作是施放一个具有射程和区域的法术，你将自己和装备传送到该法术区域内的一个开放空间。你可以选择在该法术生效之前或之后抵达。

越狱 如果你使用“越狱法术”配合此法术塑形来修改一个以单个生物为目标的法术，你可以传送到该法术射程内的任意开放空间。

Requirements You're wielding a ranged weapon with the tech trait.

You digitize yourself using your magic to move across the battlefield. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with a range and an area, you teleport yourself and your gear to one open space within the spell's area. You can choose to arrive before or after the spell takes effect.

Jailbreak If you use Jailbreak Spell with this spellshape to modify a spell that targets a single creature, you can teleport to any open space within the spell's range.

Hardlight Simulacrum.name: 硬光拟像 Hardlight Simulacrum
Hardlight Simulacrum.description:
你可以制造怪物的全息复制体来为你作战。如果你接下来使用的动作是施放一个具有召唤特征的法术，你转而召唤该生物的一个硬光拟像。硬光拟像使用与基础生物相同的属性数据，但有如下调整：它具有构装体和科技特征，对物理伤害（幽灵杀手除外）具有等同于其等级的抗性，并免疫流血、死亡效果、疾病、濒死、吸 drained、疲乏、治疗、非致命攻击、麻痹、中毒、恶心、灵魂、失去意识、生机和虚空；它失去任何带有这些特征的能力，以及施放任何带有这些特征或会赋予这些状态的法术的能力。

越狱 如果你使用“法术越狱”来运用这个法术塑形，你可以在被召唤生物被召唤后立刻以自由动作对其使用“装备超频”。

You can generate holographic replicas of monsters to fight for you. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has the summon trait, you summon a hardlight simulacrum of the creature instead. A hardlight simulacrum uses the same statistics as the base creature with the following adjustments: It has the construct and tech traits, resistance equal to its level to physical damage (except ghost killer), and immunities to bleed, death effects, disease, doomed, drained, fatigued, healing, nonlethal attacks, paralyzed, poison, sickened, spirit, unconscious, vitality, and void; it loses any abilities and the ability to cast any spells with those traits or that confer those conditions.

Jailbreak If you use Jailbreak Spell to use this spellshape, you can Overclock Gear the summoned creature as a free action immediately after it is summoned.

Signal Relay.name: 信号中继器 Signal Relay
Signal Relay.description:
需求 你对一个受你控制的科技仆从具有效果线。

如果你接下来使用的动作是施放一个只影响你自己的法术，则该法术改为影响你的仆从。

越狱 如果你使用越狱法术将这个法术塑形与一个无害法术一同使用，则该法术除了其原本目标外，还会影响该仆从。

Requirements You have line of effect to a tech minion under your control.

If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that only affects you, the spell affects your minion instead.

Jailbreak If you use Jailbreak Spell to use this spellshape with a harmless spell, the spell affects the minion in addition to its original target.

Speedrun.name: 速通 Speedrun
Speedrun.description:
你化作一道闪烁的回响，穿越现实的常规界限。你获得对所有伤害的抗性 10（力场伤害除外）。你获得太空和虚体特征，使你能够穿过墙壁，并像平常行走一样轻松地在空中移动。你可以穿过敌方所占方格移动（除非该敌人具有虚体特征），不过你的移动仍会触发反应。若你的装备处于超频状态，你可以使其不再处于超频状态，以将其持续时间额外延长 1 轮。

You become a flickering echo clipping through the normal parameters of reality. You gain resistance 10 to all damage (except force damage). You gain the cosmic and incorporeal traits, allowing you to phase through walls and move through the air as easily as you would normally walk. You can move through enemy squares (unless the enemy is incorporeal), though your movement still triggers reactions. If your gear is overclocked, you can extend its duration an additional round by making your gear no longer overclocked.

Log Spell Execution.name: 记录法术执行 Log Spell Execution
Log Spell Execution.description:
你从一个混合物品中提取代码，并将其已执行法术的临时副本解码到你的法术缓存库中。如果你的下一个动作是从法术芯片或法术宝石中施放法术，则将该法术加入你的法术缓存库，直到你使用 Download Spell 以记录的法术替换一个已准备法术，或你下一次施放“记录法术执行”为止（以先发生者为准）。你只能使用这个法术塑形来记录出现在奥术法术列表上的法术。

越狱 如果你使用 Jailbreak Spell 来运用这个法术塑形，你可以将任意传统的法术作为奥术法术记录，但你必须使用毒蛇编程语言的 Overclock Gear 效果，或通过 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.uR62fVC9FyQAMCO1]{Trick Magic Item} 获得一次成功。

You fetch the code from a hybrid item and decode a temporary copy of its executed spell into your spell cache. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from a spell chip or spell gem, add the spell to your spell cache until you use Download Spell to replace a prepared spell with the logged spell, or the next time you cast log spell execution (whichever comes first). You can only use this spellshape to log spells that appear on the arcane spell list.

Jailbreak If you use Jailbreak Spell to use this spellshape, you can log a spell of any tradition as an arcane spell, but you must use the Overclock Gear effect of the viper programming language or get a success using @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.uR62fVC9FyQAMCO1]{Trick Magic Item}.

Active Defense Firewall.name: 主动防御防火墙 Active Defense Firewall
Active Defense Firewall.description:
你将危险的魔法束缚进你的护甲中。如果你的下一个动作是施放一个具有敌对效果且以一个生物为目标的法术，你会改为将该法术储存在你的护甲中。你的护甲以这种方式只能储存一个法术；当你处于activate defense firewall的效果影响下时，你不能施放activate defense firewall。

当一个生物以徒手近战攻击或非触及近战武器接触你或对你造成伤害时，你可以以反应来施放该法术，将触发该反应的生物作为目标；触发该反应的生物对该法术处于@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。只有触发该反应的生物会受到该法术影响。

你可以解除active defense firewall。如果你这么做，用于施放被active defense firewall修改的法术的已准备法术位会恢复，但该法术本身不会恢复。这个空的法术位可以用来通过 Download Spell 准备一个法术。

You bind dangerous magic into your armor. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with a hostile effect that targets one creature, you store the spell in your armor instead. Your armor can only store one spell in this way; you can't cast activate defense firewall while you are under the effect of activate defense firewall.

When a creature touches or damages you with an unarmed melee attack or non-reach melee weapon, you can Cast the Spell as a reaction, targeting the triggering creature; the triggering creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against this spell. Only the creature who triggered the reaction is affected by the spell.

You can Dismiss active defense firewall. If you do, the prepared spell slot used to cast the spell modified by active defense firewall is recovered, but the spell is not. The empty spell slot can be used to prepare a spell with Download Spell.

Holographic Object.name: 全息物体 Holographic Object
Holographic Object.description:
你将附近的光子编织成一个静止物体的幻象全息影像。整个影像必须容纳在该法术的区域内。该物体看起来会自然地活动，但不会发出声音或产生气味。例如，幻象计算机服务器外部的灯光看起来会闪烁，但它将是无声的，也不会产生热量。任何接触该影像的生物，或使用 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} 动作来检视它的生物，都可以尝试识破你的幻象。

强化（2环） 你的全息影像会发出适当的声音，产生正常的气味，并且触摸起来感觉正确。该法术获得听觉和嗅觉特征。持续时间增加至1小时。

强化（5环） 如同2环版本，但持续时间为无限。

You weave nearby photons into an illusory hologram of a stationary object. The entire image must fit within the spell's area. The object appears to animate naturally, but it doesn't make sounds or generate smells. For example, lights would appear to blink on the exterior of an illusory computer server, but it would be silent and wouldn't produce heat. Any creature that touches the image or uses the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to examine it can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) Your hologram makes the appropriate sounds, generates normal smells, and feels right to the touch. The spell gains the auditory and olfactory traits. The duration increases to 1 hour.

Heightened (5th) As the 2nd-rank version, but the duration is unlimited.
